decisions.reason: An IMU sensor module is a core building block in the modular system, cheap to keep stocked and produced in-house, and it serves ongoing developer and educational demand.
The industrial AC voltage input module has a dedicated page and supports the firm's push into industrial automation and energy management, so it is strategically relevant.
A four-channel solid state relay is a standard control building block that complements the platform and costs little to maintain.
The server room monitoring kit bundles existing modules at low marginal cost, though it is more exposed to rationalisation as the platform moves to newer connectors.
